ActionSpec.description: One interaction action on a widget (click, double-click, middle-click, scroll).

target.description: App desktop ID, URL (`https://…`), or allowlisted command/variable name.

BackgroundImage.description: A local or theme-bundled background image for a widget surface.

path.description: Asset URL (`opaline-asset://…`) or relative path inside a theme package.

CardShape.description: Card silhouette: a rounded rectangle (default) or any of the 35 Material 3 Expressive shapes.

CommandRef.description:
A command for core, which validates it before acting (ARCHITECTURE §3.7). `cmd` is a command
name of the IPC protocol; the arguments are expressions, and `$value` is the control's new
value (slider, toggle, text input).

Composition.description: A widget as a tree of containers and blocks, with one layout per size.

bindings.description:
Named values shared by every layout, read in expressions as `bind.<name>`. A widget's
fields become bindings. Bindings may read other bindings, but not in a circle.

layouts.description: Layouts, tried in order; the first that matches the widget's size is used.

ConditionalStyle.description: An ordered conditional style rule: when `when` evaluates truthy, apply `set` over the style.

animate.description: Animate transitioning into and out of this rule (default true).

set.description: Style keys to override when the expression is truthy (no nested `conditions`).

when.description: Expression in the Opaline expression language (docs/EXPRESSIONS.md).

GradientSpec.description: A 2–4 stop gradient used for backgrounds, tints, or borders.

angle.description: Angle in degrees (0 … 360) for linear and conic gradients.

oneOf.description: The meaning ramp (thermal, load, health).

HeroOptions.description: Options for hero visuals (rings, gauges, bars, charts).

thickness.description: Stroke or bar thickness in px, 1 … 24.

HistoryRef.description: Core's history of a path over a window (`'5m'`), for charts.

IconSet.description: Material Symbols icon set (all Apache-2.0) or none.

Layout.description: One layout: the sizes it's for and its tree.

minH.description: For free sizes: the smallest height in grid cells this layout fits.

minW.description: For free sizes: the smallest width in grid cells this layout fits.

sizes.description: Size classes this layout is for; empty means any.

oneOf.description: Children side by side when the box is wider than tall, else one under the other.

grow.description: Share of the free space this container takes in its parent (like flex-grow).

oneOf.description: Children side by side.

grow.description: Share of the free space this container takes in its parent (like flex-grow).

oneOf.description: Children one under the other.

grow.description: Share of the free space this container takes in its parent (like flex-grow).

oneOf.description: Children in a grid of equal columns.

grow.description: Share of the free space this container takes in its parent (like flex-grow).

oneOf.description: Children on top of each other (a value over a ring).

grow.description: Share of the free space this container takes in its parent (like flex-grow).

oneOf.description: Empty space that takes a share of what's left.
Text from a template.

shorter.description: Shorter forms, used in order when the text doesn't fit (it's never cut).

text.description: The text shown; default: the value with at most 3 decimals.

oneOf.description: One of the library's shapes; it morphs when the name changes.

value.description: 0 … 1, or a list of parts for a stacked bar.

values.description: A list of numbers; or use `history`.

max.description: The value that is full heat (default 1).

oneOf.description: Repeats `item` for each element of `items`; inside, `$item` and `$index`.
A built-in visual (analog clock, visualizer, weather sky, photo frame).
A plugin's block (P9).

id.description:
Stable id (`[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, unique in its layout). The same id in two layouts is the
same block, so resizing morphs it.

label.description: The accessible name; generated from the content when absent.

priority.description: When space runs out, lower priorities go first (0 … 100, default 50).

role.description: What the block is for; themes style roles, not elements.

style.description: Style keys for this node (the style model, ADR 0011), applied over its role's style.

visible.description: Shown only while this is true.

oneOf.description: Digits roll (the default).

See.description: How the background shows through glass (ADR 0012).

oneOf.description: The wallpaper, sampled at the blur level (0 = sharp).
Real transparency: the desktop behind the layer window shows through.

autoHideEmpty.description: Hide the widget and reflow when empty (e.g. Now Playing with nothing playing).

blur.description: 0 (sharp) … 100 (very soft); 60 is the 1.x look (settings v2, ADR 0012).

cornerRadii.description: Per-corner radii `[topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft]` in CSS px (0 … 64).

dispersion.description: Chromatic dispersion at the glass edge, 0 … 100.

gap.description: Explicit gap between rows/elements in CSS px (0 … 32); unset follows density.

iconSize.description: Base icon size in CSS px, 10 … 64.

legibility.description: Adaptive legibility (DESIGN.md §4); off shows a contrast warning instead.

padding.description: Explicit inner padding in CSS px (0 … 48); unset follows size + density.

radius.description: CSS px, 0 … 48; unset follows the size class (28 / 32).

refractionWidth.description: Refraction band width in CSS px, 0 … 40.

shadowBlur.description: Drop shadow blur radius in CSS px, 0 … 64.

shadowOffsetX.description: Drop shadow horizontal offset in CSS px, −32 … 32.

shadowOffsetY.description: Drop shadow vertical offset in CSS px, −32 … 32.

shadowSpread.description: Drop shadow spread in CSS px, −16 … 32.

specularAngle.description: Specular light angle in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (0 … 360, default 315).

specularWidth.description: Specular rim width in percent (10 … 200, default 100).

tooltip.description: Custom tooltip shown on hover (max 200 characters).

oneOf.description: A solid custom color (`surfaceColor`), still with the chosen transparency.
Completely transparent / frameless: widget content floats directly on the wallpaper.
A 2–4 stop linear, radial, or conic gradient (`backgroundGradient`).
A local image background (`backgroundImage`).
The currently playing track's blurred album art.

Template.description: A template: text with expressions in braces, `"{cpu.load | round}%"`.

ThemeFont.description: A font bundled inside a theme package; a license file is mandatory (brief §5.2).

file.description: Relative path inside the theme package (e.g. `fonts/MyFont.woff2`).

license.description: Relative path to the font's license file inside the package (e.g. `fonts/OFL.txt`).

ThemeTokens.description: Design-level theme tokens (color source or fixed palette, motion, shape language).

palette.description: Optional fixed palette overrides keyed by M3 role (`primary`, `surface`, …) → `#rrggbb`.

WidgetActions.description: Per-gesture actions on a widget card (brief §5.1).

css.description: Optional relative path to a stylesheet inside the package (defaults to `theme.css` if present).

elements.description: Per-element style layers keyed by role (`hero`, `label`) or `#block-id`.

fonts.description: Optional bundled fonts (each must include its license file).

layouts.description: Optional composition layouts per widget kind.

style.description: Base style layer applied to every widget under this theme.
